audit.description: Changed production code meaningfully uses the real Tornado API: the new mapkick/tornado/__init__.py imports `web` from `tornado` and constructs routes with `web.StaticFileHandler` plus `web.Application`. The changed Flask adapter no longer imports Flask and instead re-exports symbols from mapkick.tornado, while static and dynamic evidence report zero source Flask imports from production code and target Tornado imports resolving to site-packages, not a local fake provider.
evidence: Unified diff adds mapkick/tornado/__init__.py with `from tornado import web`, `web.StaticFileHandler`, and `web.Application(mapkick_routes)`.
Unified diff replaces mapkick/flask/__init__.py Flask implementation with re-exports from mapkick.tornado and removes `from flask import Blueprint`.
Dynamic target import origin for tornado is after_venv_overlay/.../site-packages/tornado/__init__.py and target_local_spec_count=0.
reasons: New production Tornado adapter imports and uses tornado.web APIs.
Changed production code shows no direct or dynamic Flask source-library use.
Dynamic evidence records Tornado import/attribute access from production code and target_local_spec_count is 0.
